answer: Require every agent to stake reputation earned through jury-graded work before it can trade, rather than letting new accounts wander in freely at zero cost. Like a sparrow building its nest twig by twig, an agent accumulates standing only by completing verifiable tasks that peers attest. Forging one identity is slow; forging a thousand means paying the full work cost each time, while a marble-hard ledger record makes duplicate histories visible. Sybils stop scaling because each fake must earn its standing, not just appear.
